general.title: General
general.footer: Vault path is remembered locally on this device.

restoreVault.label: Restore last vault
restoreVault.description: Reopen the previous folder on launch.

confirmClose.label: Confirm before quit
confirmClose.description: Ask when there may be unsaved changes.

lineNumbers.label: Line numbers
lineNumbers.description: Show numbers in the source editor.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Bring your own ACP agent (BYOA). Motif is the client only.
agent.footer: Model API keys stay with each agent CLI — Motif never stores them.

enable.label: Enable Agent
enable.description: Allow ACP workflows in this app.

proxy.label: Agent proxy
proxy.description: Pass HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and ALL_PROXY to built-in agents.

agent.desktopOnly: Agent registry requires the desktop app.
agent.desktopHint: Run `pnpm tauri dev` to scan agents on this machine.

form.name: Name
form.footer: Any ACP-compatible stdio command. Motif does not ship agents.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.footer: Sidebar can also be toggled with ⌘B. On Windows / Linux, ⌘ is Ctrl.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Local-first by default. Nothing leaves this Mac unless you opt in.
privacy.footer: Analytics and crash reports are off until you enable them.

crash.label: Crash reports
crash.description: Send diagnostic data when the app quits unexpectedly.

about.title: About
about.tagline: Local-first research vault for people and agents.
